description: Header file defining the ProofSourceChromium class, which implements the quic::ProofSource interface for QUIC protocol in Chromium. It includes method declarations for initializing with certificates and keys, generating proofs, retrieving certificate chains, computing TLS signatures, and managing ticket crypters.

classes.name: ProofSourceChromium
classes.description: Implements the quic::ProofSource interface for Chromium's QUIC proof source, handling certificate and key initialization, proof generation, and TLS signature computation.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the proof source with certificate chain, private key, and optional signed certificate timestamp.

methods.name: GetProof
methods.description: Generates a cryptographic proof for the specified server and client addresses, hostname, server config, and QUIC version.

methods.name: GetCertChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain associated with the proof source.

methods.name: ComputeTlsSignature
methods.description: Computes a TLS signature using the proof source.

methods.name: GetProofInner
methods.description: Internal method to generate proof details.
